judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale:
The element is

: an empty legacy named anchor (a fragment target) with no href, no content and no box. Chrome lists it as role link, almost certainly from its heuristic for anchors with click listeners, but it is not in the tab order and nobody perceives it as a control. It is not a user interface component in WCAG's sense, and tools such as axe's link-name do not treat href-less anchors as links. Applying 4.1.2's name requirement to it is not warranted; replacing it with an id is a cleanup, not a fix for a failure. Still present on the live page.
